title: What to Include In Your LinkedIn Experience? ✍️
description:
What should go in the experience section of your LinkedIn profile? Lucky for you if have a (good) resume already build you can effectively copy it right over and drop it here. The main idea with any place you’re writing your experience is it’s not about putting your work responsibilities it’s about the impact you made. Write achievements showing work successes and include metrics for the best results. #linkedin #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips
